product_one_liner.value: Smallest.ai provides real-time speech recognition, speech synthesis and voice-agent infrastructure for enterprises building and automating voice interactions.

employee_band.notes: The reported headcount of 104 maps to this band; LinkedIn’s broader company-size range is 51–200.

eng_blog.notes: Technical posts cover inference optimization by data scientist Nityanand Mathur and the Electron V2 model by co-founder/CTO Akshat Mandloi.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live board lists Finance and Accounts Manager, Senior SDET, and Software Engineer – Systems and Reliability; none has a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title.

model_provider.value: Smallest.ai’s own Lightning (TTS), Pulse (STT), Hydra (speech-to-speech), and Electron (LLM); OpenAI is also disclosed as a subprocessor for LLM inference in specific features, tooling or evaluation.

compliance_certs.notes: These are publicly displayed compliance claims, not a finding that every certification is current. The trust center explicitly marks the SOC 2 Type II report expired in August 2026; ISO certifications, HIPAA/GDPR reports and PCI DSS certificate show validity into 2027.

last_funding.notes: The July 30–31 announcement identifies $13 million for the round; more than $21 million is cumulative funding, not the round amount.

raised_18mo.notes: The July 2026 Series A falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No qualifying SDR, BDR or account-executive title appears on the live three-role board.

launched_6mo.notes: The company’s Lightning V3 TTS launch post is dated October 5, 2026, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No qualifying C-level/VP change could be verified, and a complete dated leadership roster was not available to establish a negative answer.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These are documented product integration signals, not verified internal CRM usage by Smallest.ai. Salesforce, Zendesk and Zoho appear in integration docs; HubSpot appears in its integration guide.
